panels.description: Junos release and family come from the JTSO metadata enrichment (no extra sensor needed).

targets.query: SELECT last("if_mtu") AS "x" FROM "INTERFACES" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME", "device", "FAMILY", "VERSION"

panels.title: Device inventory

panels.description: NETCONF get-commit-information (latest commit, sequence 0). The commit_change.tick Kapacitor task raises an alert when it changes.

targets.query: SELECT last("commit_epoch") * 1000 AS "Last commit", last("commit_epoch") * 1000 AS "Age", last("commit_user") AS "User", last("commit_client") AS "Client" FROM "COMMIT" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME", "device"

panels.title: Latest commit

panels.description: cRPD: NETCONF get-system-memory-information (active/total, host memory). cSRX: SPU memory from 'show security monitoring'.

targets.query: SELECT last("mem_active_kb") / last("mem_total_kb") * 100 FROM "SYSTEM_MEMORY" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME"
SELECT last("spu_mem_pct") FROM "SECURITY_SPU" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME"

panels.title: Memory used

panels.description: NETCONF get-system-storage, mount point /. cRPD/cSRX run as containers: memory and disk values reflect the host they run on.

targets.query: SELECT last("storage_used_pct") FROM "SYSTEM_STORAGE" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME"

panels.title: Disk used (/)

panels.description: NETCONF get-flow-session-information summary.

targets.query: SELECT last("flow_active_sessions") AS "Active", last("flow_failed_sessions") AS "Failed", last("flow_max_sessions") AS "Max" FROM "SECURITY_FLOW" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME"

panels.title: Flow sessions (cSRX)

panels.description: cRPD: sum of cpu-utilization of long-running processes (gNMI /system/processes). Short-lived helpers (ifinfo, python3, ps, sh) are excluded because they report CPU relative to their own lifetime. cSRX: SPU CPU from 'show security monitoring' (data plane).

targets.query: SELECT sum("c") FROM (SELECT mean("process_cpu_utilization") AS "c" FROM "SYSTEM" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "process_name" !~ /^(ifinfo|python3|ps|sh)$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME", "process_name") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME" fill(none)
SELECT mean("spu_cpu_pct") FROM "SECURITY_SPU" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME" fill(none)

panels.title: CPU total

panels.description: NETCONF get-system-memory-information. cRPD/cSRX run as containers: memory and disk values reflect the host they run on.

targets.query: SELECT mean("mem_active_kb") * 1024 AS "active", mean("mem_free_kb") * 1024 AS "free" FROM "SYSTEM_MEMORY" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME" fill(none)

panels.title: Memory

panels.description: NETCONF get-route-summary-information.

targets.query: SELECT last("rt_destinations") AS "Destinations", last("rt_total") AS "Total routes", last("rt_active") AS "Active", last("rt_hidden") AS "Hidden" FROM "ROUTE_SUMMARY" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME", "table_name"

panels.title: Routing tables (cRPD)

panels.description: NETCONF get-flow-session-information summary.

targets.query: SELECT mean("flow_active_sessions") AS "active", mean("flow_failed_sessions") AS "failed", mean("flow_active_drop_sessions") AS "drop" FROM "SECURITY_FLOW" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME" fill(none)

panels.title: Flow sessions over time (cSRX)

panels.description: NETCONF get-flow-statistics-all, converted to rates by the Telegraf rate processor.

targets.query: SELECT mean("flow_pkts_rx_rate") AS "rx", mean("flow_pkts_tx_rate") AS "tx", mean("flow_pkts_fwd_rate") AS "fwd", mean("flow_pkts_drop_rate") AS "drop" FROM "SECURITY_FLOW" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME" fill(none)

panels.title: Flow packets (cSRX)

targets.query: SELECT last("if_oper_status") FROM "INTERFACES" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "if_name" =~ /^$interface$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME", "if_name" fill(none)
SELECT last("if_admin_status") FROM "INTERFACES" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "if_name" =~ /^$interface$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME", "if_name" fill(none)

SELECT last("if_admin_status") AS "Admin", last("if_oper_status") AS "Oper", last("if_mtu") AS "MTU", last("if_type") AS "Type", last("if_index") AS "ifIndex" FROM "INTERFACES" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "if_name" =~ /^$interface$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME", "device", "if_name"

panels.description: Collected via gNMI /interfaces/interface/state/counters (cRPD). Rates computed by the Telegraf rate processor.

targets.query: SELECT mean("in_octets_rate")*8 AS "in", mean("out_octets_rate")*8 AS "out" FROM "INTERFACES" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "if_name" =~ /^$interface$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME", "if_name" fill(none)

panels.title: Throughput

panels.description: Collected via gNMI /interfaces/interface/state/counters (cRPD). Rates computed by the Telegraf rate processor.

targets.query: SELECT mean("in_pkts_rate") AS "in", mean("out_pkts_rate") AS "out" FROM "INTERFACES" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "if_name" =~ /^$interface$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME", "if_name" fill(none)

panels.title: Packets

panels.description: Collected via gNMI /interfaces/interface/state/counters (cRPD). Rates computed by the Telegraf rate processor.

targets.query: SELECT mean("in_errors_rate") AS "in_errors", mean("out_errors_rate") AS "out_errors", mean("in_drops_rate") AS "in_drops", mean("out_drops_rate") AS "out_drops" FROM "INTERFACES" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "if_name" =~ /^$interface$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME", "if_name" fill(none)

panels.title: Errors & drops

panels.description: Collected via gNMI /interfaces/interface/state/counters (cRPD). Rates computed by the Telegraf rate processor.

targets.query: SELECT mean("mcast_in_pkts_rate") AS "mcast_in" FROM "INTERFACES" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "if_name" =~ /^$interface$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME", "if_name" fill(none)

panels.title: Multicast in

panels.description: Interfaces configured up (admin) but not operationally up.

targets.query: SELECT last("if_admin_status") AS "Admin", last("if_oper_status") AS "Oper" FROM "INTERFACES" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "if_name" =~ /^$interface$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME", "if_name"

panels.title: Interfaces in drift

defaults.noValue: No drift: every admin-up interface is oper-up

targets.query: SELECT last("if_admin_status") AS "Admin", last("if_oper_status") AS "Oper", last("if_mtu") AS "MTU" FROM "INTERFACES" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "if_name" =~ /^$interface$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME", "device", "if_name"

panels.title: Orchestrator
panels.description: UP while the orchestrator writes its heartbeat (naf_orchestrator, every ORCH_HEARTBEAT_S = 15 s, needs ORCH_INFLUX_EVENTS=true). DOWN when none arrived in the last 45 s: stopped, hung, or cannot write to InfluxDB. Check it on the VM with scripts/orchestrator.status.sh.

targets.query: SELECT last("up") FROM "naf_orchestrator" WHERE time > now() - 45s

panels.title: Autonomy level
panels.description: Current autonomy of the running orchestrator, from its heartbeat (naf_orchestrator.autonomy_level, every 15 s), so a restart at another level shows within one heartbeat. 'orchestrator down' when no heartbeat arrived in the last 45 s. Change it with PUT /autonomy?level=L1|L2|L3 (set-autonomy-level-*).

targets.query: SELECT last("autonomy_level") FROM "naf_orchestrator" WHERE time > now() - 45s

panels.title: Decisions by kind
panels.description: Orchestrator event-log kinds in the selected time range (notified, pending, remediated, no-drift, within-policy, recovered, ...).

targets.query: SELECT count("count") FROM "naf_event" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY "kind"

panels.title: Remediations (annotations)
panels.description: Grafana annotations posted by the orchestrator on every 'remediated' event (GRAFANA_ANNOTATIONS=true), tag naf.

panels.title: Alert level per alert type and device
panels.description: Level of the latest Kapacitor alert handled by the orchestrator (naf_event.level), per alert type (first part of the alert id) / device. config-change means 'a commit happened'; the logging-drift planner checks it. Decisions where the planner found nothing to fix (no-drift, within-policy) are left out.

targets.query: SELECT last("level") FROM "naf_event" WHERE $timeFilter AND "event" != '' AND "kind" !~ /^(autonomy-changed|no-drift|within-policy)$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "event", "device" fill(previous)

panels.title: Decision log (latest first)
panels.description: Every orchestrator decision (naf_event, ORCH_INFLUX_EVENTS=true): kind, alert id and level, autonomy, the executor and intent backend that acted.

targets.query: SELECT "kind", "event_id", "level", "autonomy", "executor", "intent_backend", "compensating" FROM "naf_event" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: BGP peer-as: actual vs intent
panels.description: Actual = openJTS gNMI NETWORK_INSTANCE_BGP.session_peer_as; intent = naf_intent (usecase=bgp-peer-drift). Matched on the neighbour. Kapacitor task bgp_peer_drift.

targets.query: SELECT last("session_peer_as") AS "Actual peer-as" FROM "NETWORK_INSTANCE_BGP" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME", "neighbor_address"
SELECT last("session_state") AS "State" FROM "NETWORK_INSTANCE_BGP" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND time > now() - 30d GROUP BY "neighbor_address"
SELECT last("peer_as") AS "Intended peer-as" FROM "naf_intent" WHERE "usecase" = 'bgp-peer-drift' GROUP BY "device", "neighbor_address"

panels.title: BGP group config (NETCONF)
panels.description: naf profile NAF_CONFIG (get-configuration protocols bgp, 30 s): configured peer-as and import policy per group. Last 90 s only, so removed leaves disappear.

targets.query: SELECT last("cfg_peer_as") AS "Configured peer-as", last("cfg_import") AS "Import policy" FROM "NAF_CONFIG" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND time > now() - 90s GROUP BY "SHORTNAME", "bgp_group"

panels.title: BGP session state
panels.description: gNMI on_change session-state per device and neighbour.

targets.query: SELECT last("session_state") FROM "NETWORK_INSTANCE_BGP" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME", "neighbor_address" fill(previous)

panels.title: Debug config present (BGP traceoptions)
panels.description: naf profile NAF_TRACE (get-configuration protocols bgp traceoptions, 30 s). A row means traceoptions are configured on that device. Intent: traceoptions_allowed=false unless a maintenance window is open.

targets.query: SELECT last("bgp_trace_file") AS "Trace file" FROM "NAF_TRACE" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND time > now() - 90s GROUP BY "SHORTNAME"

defaults.noValue: ✔ no BGP traceoptions on any device

panels.title: Logging intent and maintenance windows
panels.description: naf_intent usecase=logging-drift (re-seed after every intent change). window_open=true → the orchestrator answers within-policy.

targets.query: SELECT last("traceoptions_allowed") AS "Traceoptions allowed", last("window_open") AS "Window open" FROM "naf_intent" WHERE "usecase" = 'logging-drift' GROUP BY "device"

panels.title: Log file size
panels.description: naf profile NAF_LOGFILES (file list /var/log, 30 s): messages, bgp.log (exists once BGP traceoptions were enabled), interactive-commands. Scale 0-10 MB (archive size). Current files only (last 90 s, independent of the time range): a deleted file disappears.

targets.query: SELECT last("log_file_size") FROM "NAF_LOGFILES" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND time > now() - 90s GROUP BY "SHORTNAME", "log_file"

panels.title: Log growth (bytes/s)
panels.description: Rate of NAF_LOGFILES.log_file_size. bgp.log growing = traceoptions active; messages jumps with 'any any'. Baseline messages growth comes from openJTS's own NETCONF polling (interactive-commands any). Negative rates (rotation) are hidden.

targets.query: SELECT mean("log_file_size_rate") FROM "NAF_LOGFILES" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter AND "log_file_size_rate" >= 0 GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME", "log_file" fill(none)

panels.title: Latest commit
panels.description: openJTS naf profile COMMIT (get-commit-information, newest entry, 30 s). Every change of commit time raises config-change:<device>.

targets.query: SELECT last("commit_epoch") * 1000 AS "Last commit", last("commit_epoch") * 1000 AS "Age", last("commit_user") AS "User", last("commit_client") AS "Client" FROM "COMMIT" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME"

panels.title: RX prefixes vs. MAX RX prefixes
panels.description: RX prefixes: openJTS gNMI safi_received (accepted after import policy, IPV4_UNICAST), one line per session. MAX RX prefixes (dashed red): the maximum RX prefixes in intent (naf_intent, hidden dashboard variable $max_rx_prefixes). Threshold lines: 40 = WARNING (80 % of MAX RX prefixes), 50 = CRITICAL (MAX RX prefixes). Above 50 the router tears the session down (accepted-prefix-limit), so the line drops to 0 while the session flaps: see Session resets sent. Kapacitor task prefix_limit.

targets.query: SELECT last("safi_received") FROM "NETWORK_INSTANCE_BGP" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "neighbor_afi_safi_name" = 'IPV4_UNICAST' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME", "neighbor_address" fill(previous)

SELECT last("safi_received") * 0 + $max_rx_prefixes AS "MAX RX prefixes" FROM "NETWORK_INSTANCE_BGP" WHERE "neighbor_afi_safi_name" = 'IPV4_UNICAST' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

panels.title: Pre-policy vs accepted (clamp effect)
panels.description: safi_received_pre_policy (what the neighbour sends) vs safi_received (what passes the import policy). After the IMPORT-CLAMP the lines split: ~205 sent, 3 accepted.

targets.query: SELECT last("safi_received_pre_policy") FROM "NETWORK_INSTANCE_BGP" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "neighbor_afi_safi_name" = 'IPV4_UNICAST' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME", "neighbor_address" fill(previous)

SELECT last("safi_received") FROM "NETWORK_INSTANCE_BGP" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND "neighbor_afi_safi_name" = 'IPV4_UNICAST' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME", "neighbor_address" fill(previous)

panels.title: Import clamp (compensating action)
panels.description: NAF_CONFIG.cfg_import (last 90 s). IMPORT-CLAMP-<group> (orange) = the orchestrator's compensating action is in place; it stays until a human removes it. INPUT-POLICY-ONLY-<peer> (green) = the intended import policy of intent v2 (scripts/update_intent.py).

targets.query: SELECT last("cfg_peer_as") AS "peer-as", last("cfg_import") AS "Import policy" FROM "NAF_CONFIG" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND time > now() - 90s GROUP BY "SHORTNAME", "bgp_group"

panels.title: Prefix intent
panels.description: naf_intent usecase=prefix-limit (minimum and maximum RX prefixes per device and neighbour) and the intended import policy (usecase=bgp-peer-drift; 'none' in intent v1, INPUT-POLICY-ONLY-<peer> after scripts/update_intent.py).

targets.query: SELECT last("rx_min") AS "Minimum RX prefixes", last("rx_max") AS "Maximum RX prefixes" FROM "naf_intent" WHERE "usecase" = 'prefix-limit' GROUP BY "device", "neighbor_address"
SELECT last("import_policy") AS "Intended import policy" FROM "naf_intent" WHERE "usecase" = 'bgp-peer-drift' GROUP BY "device", "neighbor_address"

panels.title: Session resets sent (prefix-limit teardown)
panels.description: BGP NOTIFICATIONs this router sent per minute (session_notif_sent = neighbor/state/messages/sent/NOTIFICATION). Only the router that tears the session down sends them: pe1 when its accepted-prefix-limit is exceeded. Kapacitor prefix_limit raises CRITICAL at 2 or more in 3 min, if the session also reached Established 2 or more times (session_flaps).

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_difference(last("session_notif_sent")) FROM "NETWORK_INSTANCE_BGP" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1m), "SHORTNAME", "neighbor_address" fill(none)

panels.title: BGP session state
panels.description: gNMI on_change session-state per device and neighbour (same panel as in NAF · bgp-peer-drift). While pe1's accepted-prefix-limit tears the session down, both ends flicker between ESTABLISHED (green) and the other states (red); with the clamp or the fix it stays green.

targets.query: SELECT last("session_state") FROM "NETWORK_INSTANCE_BGP" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "SHORTNAME", "neighbor_address" fill(previous)

panels.title: csrx rule order: actual vs intent
panels.description: Actual = naf_secpolicy (collector/netconf_poller.py --only secpolicy); intent = naf_intent usecase=security-policy-drift. One row per zone pair; Actual order ≠ Intended order raises security-policy-drift:csrx. Actual is empty when the poller is not running.

targets.query: SELECT last("rule_order") AS "Actual order", last("rule_count") AS "Actual rules" FROM "naf_secpolicy" WHERE time > now() - 90s GROUP BY "device", "from_zone", "to_zone"
SELECT last("rule_order") AS "Intended order", last("rule_count") AS "Intended rules" FROM "naf_intent" WHERE "usecase" = 'security-policy-drift' GROUP BY "device", "from_zone", "to_zone"

defaults.noValue: no data: is the poller running? (--only secpolicy)

panels.title: Collector A: openJTS profile (COMMIT poll)
panels.description: naf profile COMMIT, the default Collector for logging-drift.

targets.query: SELECT last("commit_epoch") * 1000 AS "Newest commit", last("commit_user") AS "User" FROM "COMMIT" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "SHORTNAME"

panels.title: Collector B: Python poller (naf_commit)
panels.description: collector/netconf_poller.py, the alternative Collector component. Same values as A when it runs.

targets.query: SELECT last("commit_epoch") * 1000 AS "Newest commit", last("user") AS "User" FROM "naf_commit" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY "device"

panels.title: Collector C: syslog push (naf_syslog)
panels.description: telegraf_naf_syslog (compose profile naf-syslog): UI_COMMIT_COMPLETED pushed by the devices. Arrives ~5 s after a commit instead of ~30 s.

targets.query: SELECT count("message") AS "Commit messages", last("message") AS "Last message" FROM "naf_syslog" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY "hostname"

panels.title: Which Intent backend and Executor acted
panels.description: naf_event decisions that reached the Executor (pending / remediated / no-drift), grouped by the Intent backend and Executor in use. Same id, plan and diff whatever the blocks.

targets.query: SELECT count("count") AS "Decisions" FROM "naf_event" WHERE $timeFilter AND "kind" =~ /^(pending|remediated|no-drift)$/ GROUP BY "intent_backend", "executor", "kind"

list.name: device
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "INTERFACES" WITH KEY = "SHORTNAME"

list.label: Interface
list.name: interface
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "INTERFACES" WITH KEY = "if_name" WHERE "SHORTNAME" =~ /^$device$/

list.name: max_rx_prefixes
list.label: MAX RX prefixes
list.query: SELECT max("rx_max") FROM (SELECT last("rx_max") AS "rx_max" FROM "naf_intent" WHERE "usecase" = 'prefix-limit' GROUP BY "device", "neighbor_address")
